events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in the Claude 5.5 family; it was described as costing 40% less on typical workloads than Opus 5.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5

events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5, which it said runs 30%+ faster and costs up to 30% less per task than Sonnet 5; listed token pricing remained $2/$10 per million input/output tokens.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5

events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027.
events.headline: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers

events.summary: Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program with three access tiers, giving qualifying security professionals access to advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers.
events.headline: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program

events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume, cost-sensitive work and said it costs around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average.
events.headline: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5

events.summary: Anthropic launched the Cyber Mission, including OSS Scanner, a free opt-in service that periodically scans enrolled open-source projects for vulnerabilities and suggests fixes.
events.headline: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission

events.summary: Anthropic opened a Singapore office—its fifth in Asia-Pacific—and signed a memorandum of understanding with Singapore’s Ministry of Digital Development and Information.
events.headline: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs government MOU

events.summary: Anthropic announced that it is committing a portion of its shares to a new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, with the fund’s stake structured to increase as the company grows.
events.headline: Investing in the public benefit

events.summary: Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Harvard Dean of Science, joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust.
events.headline: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust

events.summary: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills standard, its name and logo, GitHub organization, and agentskills.io domain to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation.
events.headline: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

events.summary: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 registration statement for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock; the filing said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined.
events.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed initial public offering

events.summary: Anthropic expanded its partnership with the U.S. General Services Administration so agencies can use Claude for sensitive unclassified work, with discounts estimated to save the government $1 billion.
events.headline: Expanding partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government

events.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program to 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups, providing free Claude credits for high-impact scientific projects.
events.headline: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
